modifiers.description: Significant, Separately Identifiable Evaluation and Management Service by the Same Physician or Other Qualified Health Care Professional on the Same Day of the Procedure or Other Service
modifiers.justification: 99203 is a problem-oriented new patient E/M. 99387 is a preventive/wellness E/M for a new patient age 65+ (used here to represent the wellness exam). Both are billed on the same date by the same provider. Per Modifier 25 rules, when a preventive E/M (99381–99397) and a problem-oriented E/M (99202–99215) are reported together, modifier 25 is appended to the problem-oriented E/M if there is a significant, separately identifiable problem-oriented service. Documentation shows a full preventive wellness exam was performed ("for wellness exam" and "Wellness exam done") and, in addition, a distinct evaluation of acute right knee pain: detailed HPI (onset with spin classes, aggravating/relieving factors, prior treatment, lack of prior injury), focused musculoskeletal and neurologic exams, and an assessment/plan for "Right knee sprain" with rest, activity modification, brace, OTC meds, and exercises. This work clearly exceeds what is inherent to a routine preventive visit and would support a stand-alone 99203. Therefore, modifier 25 is appropriately appended to 99203 to indicate that it is a significant, separately identifiable E/M service beyond the preventive service 99387.
